LINKEDIN POST 1: Tuesday, March 17

"The System Nobody Sees"

Platform: LinkedIn (Ambition Mechanical company page) Type: Text + photo Status: DRAFT. Patrik/Ash approval required.

Photo: Pull a still from 20250908_Memorial Tower/S5iiX PHOTOS/ or 20251018_Abrazo Healthcare/S5iiX PHOTO/ showing HVAC equipment on a rooftop or in a mechanical room. The messier and more industrial the better. This is about showing the hidden infrastructure.

Every building you walk into has a system keeping it comfortable.

Rooftop units running in 115-degree heat. Piping threaded through ceilings you'll never see. Controls calibrated so the temperature is right before anyone walks through the door.

That's what Ambition Mechanical does. 22 years of commercial HVAC, plumbing, and piping across Phoenix. Hospitals. Schools. Restaurants. Data centers. The kind of facilities where the system can't go down.

We just wrapped a complete mechanical install at Scottsdale Fashion Square for Din Tai Fung. Custom ductwork, grease exhaust, makeup air. Every line run clean, every connection tight.

If your building is running right, it's because somebody like us made sure it does.

ambitionac.com | (480) 600-2942

#CommercialHVAC #PhoenixContractor #MechanicalContractor #HVAC #ArizonaConstruction #AmbitionMechanical

Word count: 130 Content pillar: The Work / Authority Why it works: Opens with empathy (the system you don't think about), transitions to capability, closes with a specific project reference (Din Tai Fung at Fashion Square). Credible and grounded. No corporate speak.

HANDOFF NOTES

For Steffen (Remotion Animations)

  • All 5 videos follow the same structure: hook (2s) > establishing (2-3s) > the work (5-6s) > payoff (2-3s) > CTA (3s)
  • Use the Ambition overlay templates you specced (social-templates-spec.md)
  • Hook text uses Section 2.1 spec. Location bar uses Section 1.2. Equipment callouts use Section 1.5. CTA end card uses Section 2.5.
  • Colors locked: navy #0a0e2a backgrounds, red #dc2626 accents, Barlow Condensed headlines, Inter body text
  • All video exports: 1080x1920, 24fps, H.264, 12 Mbps
  • Footage clips will be cut to specified timestamps by Cleo and placed in a shared folder for Remotion import

For Cleo (Footage Extraction)

  • Priority 1: Pull clips from the 5 source folders listed in briefs
  • Each clip should be 2-5 seconds. Short, punchy cuts.
  • Vertical framing (9:16). Crop if source is horizontal. Focus on the center of action when cropping.
  • Color grade: cool-neutral per brand guidelines. No warm/orange. Apply Ambition LUT if available.
  • Audio: strip all audio from clips. Steffen's Remotion template handles music and VO.
  • Name files: amb-w1-[brief#]-[clip#].mov (e.g., amb-w1-01-establishing-drone.mov)

For Tony/Ash (Posting)

  • LinkedIn posts are ready to copy-paste. Only edit needed: confirm phone number and client name clearance.
  • Video captions included in each brief. Copy-paste.
  • Hashtags go in the first comment, not the caption.
  • Post times: IG/TikTok at 11am AZ time (peak construction scroll), LinkedIn at 8am AZ time (morning commute).
  • Tag Ambition Mechanical account on all platforms. Tag location when posting project-specific content.

Week 1 sets the baseline. 5 videos. 2 LinkedIn posts. 7 pieces of content in 5 days. The footage exists. The templates exist. Time to ship.
